_meta.note: Route structure and fares are from the 2025-26 season. 2026-27 timetables are picked up automatically by scripts/update_shuttle.py; until then the app shows routes and links to the official timetable.

passNote: A Hakuba Valley All-Mountain pass (season or day) lets you ride the Hakuba Valley Shuttle free on the day you ski.

systems.name: Hakuba Valley Shuttle
systems.fare: ¥800 adult / ¥400 child · online ticket only, no cash
systems.lastSeasonPeriod: 2025-26: mid-Dec to late Mar (timetable changes in Dec and mid-Mar)
tips: Buses fill up on powder days — once full they skip stops.
Mornings mostly run toward the resorts, afternoons back from them.

systems.name: Hakuba Night Bus
systems.lastSeasonPeriod: Peak season only; the loop ended in early March in 2024-25
tips: Links accommodation areas with restaurants and bars after skiing.

systems.name: Gurutto Bus (Omachi ⇄ Hakuba)
tips: About 30 min from Omachi Onsenkyo to the Hakuba ski area.

systems.name: Goryu & Hakuba47 Free Shuttle + Triangle Bus
tips: Triangle Bus links Goryu, Iimori and Hakuba47 bases.
